topic: Same-revision imported DXF POINTCLOUDEX DefinitionEx/ReactorEx graph output

scope.implementation_revision_gate: AC1027 through AC1032; target revision must equal the completed source revision
scope.fixture_policy: Generated locally in temporary paths; no fixture file added

source_binding: Binds complete physical OBJECTS records to raw carriers and retained typed callbacks.
Defers physical/source revision equality until output preflight because dxfRW finalizes sourceVersion only after the import callback sequence completes.
Normalizes a complete ACAD_REACTORS application group into the typed reactor handle list and sets its corresponding common-object reactor count.
graph_admission: Requires the NOD ACAD_POINTCLOUD_EX_DICT edge and uniquely owned definition dictionary.
Requires complete DefinitionEx and ReactorEx identity, owner, reciprocal reactor, entity reference, uniqueness, collision, and class metadata checks.
Uses staged serializers, output identity reservation/remapping, and resolved entity/object references; DWG-origin graphs remain refused.
implementation.failure_and_retry: Mutated POINTCLOUDEX definition-reference and class-version source/model values fail before output and preserve the existing destination. Restoring the values allows the same adapter to retry successfully.
implementation.readback: A fresh importer verifies the NOD-to-definition-dictionary-to-DefinitionEx path, dictionary entry, DefinitionEx reactor list, ReactorEx owner, POINTCLOUDEX owner, and both entity references.

limitations: Generated AC1027 transport evidence only; AC1027+ physical-producer breadth and native-consumer behavior are not established.
DWG source CLASS/frame/output binding, cross-revision conversion, asset loading, and native 3D semantics remain open.
This slice does not close P4 source/graph profiles or the complete P8 consumer/platform/release gates.
